Beginner glossary

algorithm

A step-by-step recipe for solving a problem. Example: steps to make tea.

source code

Human-readable instructions you write. Java source files end in .java.

compiler (javac)

Tool that translates source code into bytecode and reports syntax errors.

JVM

Java Virtual Machine — runs bytecode on any computer. Write once, run anywhere.

JDK

Java Development Kit — everything to write and build Java (javac, java, libraries).

JRE

Java Runtime Environment — everything to run Java (no compiler). Part of the JDK idea.

variable

A named storage box holding one value. Has a type, name, and value.

data type

What kind of value something holds: int, double, boolean, String…

literal

A value written directly: 42, 3.5, 'a', "hi", true.

constant (final)

A variable that cannot change after set. Written in UPPER_CASE.

casting

Converting one type to another: (int) 3.9 → 3. May lose info.

operator

Symbol doing work: + - * / % = == && || !.

String

Text object in Java. Immutable — methods return new strings.

Scanner

Helper to read keyboard input: new Scanner(System.in).

boolean expression

Anything true or false: age >= 18, x == 5.

method

A reusable named recipe: takes inputs, does work, may return a result.

parameter

Input slot of a method. Argument is the actual value passed.

scope

Where a variable can be seen. Block { } limits lifetime.

array

Fixed-size row of boxes of one type. Index starts at 0.

index

Position in an array/String. First is 0, last is length-1.

2D array

Grid: array of arrays. Think cinema seats [row][seat].

immutability

Cannot change after creation. Strings are immutable — use StringBuilder to build.

StringBuilder

Mutable text builder for loops and edits. toString() at the end.

class

Blueprint for objects. Defines fields (info) + methods (actions).

object

One real thing built from a class: new Book(...). Has state + behavior.

field

Variable inside a class describing state (title, pages).

constructor

Special method that builds an object: same name as class, no return type.

this

Means 'this object'. Tells fields apart from parameters.

encapsulation

Hide insides, show safe controls. Private fields + public methods.

access modifier

Who can see it: private < package < protected < public.

static

Belongs to the class, not each object. Shared counter, Math.max().

inheritance

Child class reuses parent: extends. One parent only in Java.

overriding

Child replaces parent method with its own version (@Override).

overloading

Same name, different inputs. Not the same as overriding.

polymorphism

One type, many behaviors: Animal a = new Dog(); a.speak() barks.

abstract class

Half-built blueprint. Cannot use new directly; children finish it.

interface

Pure contract: what to do, no how. A class can implement many.

composition

Has-a instead of is-a: Library has Books. Prefer when reuse only.

package

Folder for classes: com.shop.cart. import brings others in.

exception

Unexpected event at runtime: file missing, bad input. Must handle or declare.

try/catch/finally

Try risky code, catch problems, finally always runs (cleanup).

checked vs unchecked

Checked (IOException) must be handled; unchecked (NullPointer) is a bug to fix.

collections

Ready-made storage: List (order), Set (unique), Map (key→value).

ArrayList

Growable list. Use instead of arrays when size changes.

HashMap

Key→value shelf: get("ana") → record. Keys unique.

generics

Type in < >: List<String> only holds Strings. Catches errors early.

enum

Fixed set of choices: MON, TUE… or SMALL, MEDIUM. Safer than strings.

try-with-resources

Auto-close files: try (var f = open(...)) { }. Always use for files.

unit test (JUnit)

Tiny robot checking one method: expected vs actual. @Test + assertEquals.

Maven

Build helper: builds, tests, fetches libraries. Described in pom.xml.
